cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 reports duplicate declarations of the built-in srandom member/function when this inherited randomization case seeds the same object through both derived and base handles. IEEE 1800-2023 18.6.2 and 18.13.3 permit dynamic class randomization and object seeding. Celox preserves the assertions for inherited hidden members and hook dispatch.

cases.name: class::randomization_mode_bit_argument
cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 treats rand_mode(2) as enabled for both member and object-wide setters. IEEE 1800-2023 18.8 declares a bit on_off formal, so integral 2 truncates to zero. The case records two assertion failures; generated C++ sets the mode to 1 for these calls. Celox retains the required bit conversion.
